title: Memory preserved outside the constants
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, $N\in\bbn$, and let $m:\bbr\to\text{BitVec}(W)$ be a memory. First initialize the cells at addresses $-5$, $-7$, and $-9$ to $1$, $0$, and $-1$, respectively, and then initialize the pool cells at addresses $-(25+4n)$ for $0\le n\le N$. The resulting memory agrees with $m$ at every integer address outside the union of those three constant addresses and the pool addresses.
